info.name: Electro
info.description: Electro, electrofunk, electroclash and electro-punk: 808 beats, FM bass, talk box, clavinet, distorted drum machines, and two songs.

songs.name: Electroclash
songs.description: An electroclash song in D minor at 128 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, verse, chorus, verse, chorus, break, last chorus and outro on the five Electroclash patterns, over Dm, Dm, B flat and C. The bass's filter opens over the intro; the riff comes in halfway through the first verse; kick and bass stop for the last beat before each chorus; the riff's echo runs away at the end of the break, and over the outro the bass fades out.

songs.name: Electro-Punk
songs.description: An electro-punk song in E minor at 132 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, verse, chorus, verse, chorus, breakdown, chorus and ending on the five Electro-Punk patterns, over E, C, G and D. Every chorus comes in after a beat of silence; the guitar pans across the second verse; the breakdown's bass opens up over its last two measures, and the last chorus crushes the lead harder before the final hit.

patterns.name: Electro
patterns.description: Electro, 1 measure: kick on every beat with soft 2& and 4&, snare on 2 and 4, syncopated closed and open hats; 16th clap figures from 2e every 3 passes.

patterns.name: Electro FM Bass
patterns.description: Electro with an FM bass, 1 measure: robot-funk line in C minor, root on 1 and 1a, minor third on 2&, fifth with a seventh answer on 3 and 3a, root pushed on 4a.

patterns.name: Electrofunk Talk
patterns.description: Electrofunk, 2 measures in A dorian: a rubbery analog bass jumping octaves on Am7, then D9, with a chromatic walk back to A; synth brass stabs on the offbeats, the D9 pushed a 16th early.

patterns.name: Electrofunk Clav
patterns.description: Electrofunk, 2 measures in E minor: a square bass popping octaves on Em9, then Cmaj9 and B7#9 on half a measure each; staccato clavinet 16ths on the same chords, 808 cowbell on the offbeats.

patterns.name: Electrofunk Slow Jam
patterns.description: Electrofunk slow jam, 4 measures in D minor: Dm9, G9, Bbmaj7 and A7#9 on a warm pad, an analog bass on the root with an octave pop and the fifth on 3&, the last measure climbing back to D through C#.

patterns.name: Electroclash Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Electroclash demo, 4 measures in D minor at 128 BPM, all synth sounds: an 808 kick on every beat, off-beat hats, a cowbell in ping-pong delay and the octave bass on D, D, B flat and C.

patterns.name: Electroclash Verse
patterns.description: The verse of the Electroclash demo, 4 measures in D minor at 128 BPM: 808 kick, clap on 2 and 4, 16th hats and cowbell, the octave bass bouncing on each 8th and a sleazy resonant saw riff in 16ths.

patterns.name: Electroclash Chorus
patterns.description: The chorus of the Electroclash demo, 4 measures in D minor at 128 BPM: the verse with snare under the clap, open hats, chord stabs on every off-beat and the riff an octave up.

patterns.name: Electroclash Break
patterns.description: The break of the Electroclash demo, 4 measures in D minor: no kick and no bass, a sweeping pad on the chords, the riff alone in its echo, laser zaps, and an 808 snare roll over the last measure.

patterns.name: Electroclash Chorus 2
patterns.description: The last chorus of the Electroclash demo, 4 measures in D minor at 128 BPM: the chorus with a crash, a busier riff climbing an octave, the zaps and a tom fill at the end.

patterns.name: Electro-Punk Loop
patterns.description: Minimal UK electro-punk, 4 measures in E at 100 BPM, all synth sounds, made to rant over: a dry, crushed drum machine loop (kick on 1, the a of 2, 3 and the & of 3, a hard snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats), a stubborn overdriven bass riff in 8ths, two measures played twice, and a cheap keyboard stab on the & of 4 every second measure.

patterns.name: Electro-Punk Intro
patterns.description: The intro of the Electro-Punk demo, 4 measures in E minor at 132 BPM, all synth sounds: the overdriven bass alone on E, C, G and D in 8ths over crushed hats, then a snare count-in on the last measure.

patterns.name: Electro-Punk Verse
patterns.description: The verse of the Electro-Punk demo, 4 measures in E minor at 132 BPM: a distorted, crushed drum machine (kick on 1, the & of 2, 3 and the a of 3, snare on 2 and 4), the bass in 8ths climbing to the 5th and the octave, and a synth guitar chopping power chords on the off-beats.

patterns.name: Electro-Punk Chorus
patterns.description: The chorus of the Electro-Punk demo, 4 measures in E minor at 132 BPM: a crash on every beat, the power chords held a measure each, a screaming sync lead riff in ping-pong delay and a tom fill at the end.

patterns.name: Electro-Punk Breakdown
patterns.description: The breakdown of the Electro-Punk demo, 4 measures in E minor: half time (kick on 1, snare on 3), the bass on the roots alone, the hats and the sync lead.

patterns.name: Electro-Punk Ending
patterns.description: The ending of the Electro-Punk demo, 4 measures in E minor: the chorus for three measures and a beat, a crash on every beat, then the last hit on E, kick, snare, crash, bass and guitar together, after a tom fill.
